about.title: About Qi Code Academy
about.lead: A Boston nonprofit where people of all ages can learn, move, create, and connect.
mission: Qi Code Academy empowers youth and older adults in Boston's inner-city communities through technology education, workforce development, wellness, community engagement, and research.

We create opportunities for young people to build practical skills in Python programming, game development, artificial intelligence, 3D animation, and emerging technologies while developing pathways toward higher education, entrepreneurship, and careers.
We support older adults through traditional Tai Chi, Baguazhang, yoga, movement, wellness education, social engagement, and community resources designed to encourage healthy and active aging.

Qi Code Academy also seeks to advance community-based research into traditional movement and mind-body practices, including the study of Baguazhang and its potential relationship to balance, mobility, functional health, and healthy aging.

Our programs initially serve Dorchester, Roxbury, Mattapan, Hyde Park, the South End, and other underserved Boston communities, creating spaces where people can learn, move, connect, create, and grow.
about.vision: Boston neighborhoods where young people have real pathways into technology, older adults stay active and connected, and every generation has something to teach the others.

features.title: Games first
features.body: Every concept is introduced because a game needs it.

features.title: Movement built in
features.body: Each class opens, resets, and closes with Tai Chi and Qigong-based movement to help students stay focused.

features.title: Mistakes are part of learning
features.body: The instructor codes live, errors included, so students see that debugging is normal.

features.title: Never stranded
features.body: Each week starts from a ready-made starter file, so a missed session doesn't leave anyone behind.

features.title: Career exploration
features.body: Career spotlights and guest speakers connect each project to real jobs in software, games, data, cybersecurity, design, and 3D animation.

features.title: Demo Day
features.body: Students present their original games to family and community.

features.title: Responsible AI
features.body: AI tools are introduced in Week 10 only with written parental consent, and students learn to check AI output critically.

features.title: Privacy
features.body: Students are never required to publish their full names or personal information online.

seniors.title: Senior Wellness & Healthy Aging
seniors.lead: Traditional movement, wellness, and friendship for older adults, designed to encourage healthy and active aging.
seniors.intro: We support older adults through traditional Tai Chi, Baguazhang, yoga, movement, wellness education, social engagement, and community resources. Classes are welcoming to all experience levels.
seniors.flowLead: Program gatherings pair movement with time to connect.
seniors.noPrograms: No senior programs are open right now. Check back soon, or contact us to be notified.
seniors.modulesLead: What we practice together, and how students progress over time.
seniors.join: Classes are ongoing, not fixed-length courses. New participants learn foundations while returning students keep developing. No one needs to memorize a whole form to take part.
safety: Higher, shorter stances instead of deep ones
Large circles and slow direction changes in Baguazhang
A chair nearby for balance or seated practice
Range of motion never pushed past what is comfortable
seniors.researchNote: Tai Chi has been widely studied for balance in older adults, though results vary by person and program. Research on Baguazhang specifically is more limited — which is part of why we hope to study it.

inter.intro: In our intergenerational programs, youth help older adults with smartphones, tablets, video calls, and everyday technology. Along the way, generations share stories, skills, and friendship.
inter.youthGain: Leadership experience, patience, communication skills, and the confidence that comes from teaching.
inter.seniorGain: Digital skills for staying connected with family, friends, and community resources.

research.title: Research & Community Health
research.lead: Building toward community-based research into traditional movement and mind-body practices.
research.vision: Our long-term goal is to partner with universities, hospitals, researchers, and medical institutions on scientific research into movement and mind-body practices, especially Baguazhang and its potential relationship to balance, mobility, fall-risk factors, functional movement, healthy aging, and quality of life among older adults.
research.visionNote: We do not make health claims about these practices. Questions like these are exactly what careful research is for.

research.roadmapLead: Where we plan to go, step by step.
roadmap: We will build a track record.

We will partner with a university or medical research team on a formal clinical study.
